steps.description: Start at intersection 0 at time 0, with 1 way to be there. ways[] counts the routes that reach each node in its shortest time so far.

variables.timeArr: [0, inf, inf, inf, inf, inf, inf]

steps.description: Poll 0 at time 0, reached in 1 way. Try each road out of it.

variables.timeArr: [0, inf, inf, inf, inf, inf, inf]

steps.description: 0 -> 6 arrives at 0 + 7 = 7, the fastest so far. Every fastest route to 6 runs through 0 now: ways[6] = ways[0] = 1.
0 -> 1 arrives at 0 + 2 = 2, the fastest so far. Every fastest route to 1 runs through 0 now: ways[1] = ways[0] = 1.
0 -> 4 arrives at 0 + 5 = 5, the fastest so far. Every fastest route to 4 runs through 0 now: ways[4] = ways[0] = 1.
Poll 1 at time 2, reached in 1 way. Try each road out of it.
1 -> 2 arrives at 2 + 3 = 5, the fastest so far. Every fastest route to 2 runs through 1 now: ways[2] = ways[1] = 1.
1 -> 3 arrives at 2 + 3 = 5, the fastest so far. Every fastest route to 3 runs through 1 now: ways[3] = ways[1] = 1.
Poll 4 at time 5, reached in 1 way. Try each road out of it.
4 -> 6 also arrives at 7, tying the fastest time. Add 4's routes: ways[6] = 2.
Poll 3 at time 5, reached in 1 way. Try each road out of it.
3 -> 5 arrives at 5 + 1 = 6, the fastest so far. Every fastest route to 5 runs through 3 now: ways[5] = ways[3] = 1.
Poll 2 at time 5, reached in 1 way. Try each road out of it.
2 -> 5 also arrives at 6, tying the fastest time. Add 2's routes: ways[5] = 2.
Poll 5 at time 6, reached in 2 ways. Try each road out of it.
5 -> 6 also arrives at 7, tying the fastest time. Add 5's routes: ways[6] = 4.
Poll 6 at time 7, reached in 4 ways. Try each road out of it.
The queue is empty. Intersection 6 is reached in 4 shortest ways. Return ways[6].
